## Orientation

Work only in ~/se-workflow on branch feat/dashboard-ui. The app is `scripts/dashboard_app.py` (f84a229), a PEP 723 script run with `uv run --script`; `main` handles `--once` and `--interval`. Launcher tests set a fake HOME, and uv keeps its cache under HOME, so pass the real `UV_CACHE_DIR` (or a fake uv on PATH) through or each test re-downloads textual. The tmux tests start a real client in a pty; the Textual app draws with the alternate screen, so wait on text that the app renders. `dashboard-status` stays unchanged, including its use of the `project:dashboard` view.
